title: Trucks waiting at a loading dock
intro: A distribution center counted the trucks waiting at the loading dock at 8:00 on many mornings. X is the number of trucks waiting, from 0 to 4, and the table gives the probability of each count. The value of interest is k = 2: read P(X = 2), the chance of exactly two trucks, and P(X ≤ 2), the chance of at most two. The probabilities add to 1, as every distribution's must.
